subject: general
question: In the context of web pages, what does SEO stands for?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Search Engine Optimisation.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SEO** is the practice of enhancing web pages to increase their visibility in search engine results.
 
• The primary goal of SEO is to attract **organic traffic** from search engines like Google, Bing, and Yahoo.
 
• SEO involves various **techniques, including keyword research, on-page optimization, and backlink building.**
 
• Effective SEO strategies can **lead to higher search rankings, increased website traffic, and improved user engagement**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **On-Page SEO**: This includes optimizing content, HTML tags (like title and meta tags), and internal linking to improve the relevance and quality of a webpage.
 
• **Off-Page SEO**: Involves strategies implemented outside the website to improve its position in search rankings, such as building backlinks and social media marketing.
 
• **Technical SEO**: Focuses on improving the technical aspects of a website, like site speed, mobile-friendliness, and secure connections (HTTPS), to enhance the user experience and search engine crawlability.
 
• **SEO Tools**: Various tools are available to help with SEO analysis and tracking, including Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs, which provide insights into keyword performance and site health.
